text: Binary flag from the OP's own argument text only (column "argument", current text including marked edits): 1 if it contains at least one explicit conditional statement linking an outcome/consequence to a specific antecedent condition (if/then, unless, provided that, whenever, when X then Y); 0 if the argument is present but has none. Vague hedges without a stated antecedent-outcome link and mere questions don't count; quoted text attributed to others and not adopted by the OP doesn't count. Excluded from evidence: OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred (even inside the argument); generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and stays eligible. Missing or malformed argument returns null.
